description: Flood Study — Citywide Overland Flow — Cabbage Tree Sub-Model is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Council Citywide Creek and Overland Flow Path Mapping Flood Study Cabbage Tree Sub-Model. This dataset contains reports, data and metadata used in the flood study, and results data for the existing floodplain condition scenarios. Council is committed to ensuring we have the latest flood modelling data to help manage flood risk in Brisbane. Coverage: Brisbane, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are catchment, flood, flood map, flood study, overland. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2024-06-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
